kind_of_no: private seasonal-looking lake park with no price indicator and no presence of its own; no sign nights are sold to the public
why: Google Maps 'Basler Private Rv Park' (3199 Basler Court, Wentworth SD 57075; RV park, 4.6/26, (605) 351-7315, no website - the panel offers 'Add website'; read 2026-11-22, limited view) is the only presence. The reviews that show describe a community, not overnight stays: 'It's so nice and seems like a great community' (3 years ago), 'Sure has changed in 40+years' (5 months ago), plus the summary snippets 'Great place to make memories with family and friends!' and 'So appreciate the facilities and dock access!!'. No rate or nightly sale anywhere: not in RV Life's index (Algolia bbox 43.88..43.97 N, -97.03..-96.90 and a 'Basler' query, both 2026-11-22), not in the Good Sam directory cache, no Campspot/RoverPass/Hipcamp/Facebook page or own website found by web search; rvinglife.com's listing (read 2026-11-22) says 'We have the location and not much else'. Fails the private price indicator and long-stay test 2 (a park that looks seasonal needs a posted nightly rate or a booking site), and the name itself says 'Private'.
name: Basler Private RV Park
flags: Esri World Imagery crop (sat.py, 900 m frame, rendered, 2026-11-22) at the Google point 43.928913,-96.960342: about 50 RVs packed in four or five tight parallel rows in a block roughly 120 x 100 m on the north shore of Lake Madison, beside a farmstead and lake houses at the end of the county road - the look of a seasonal park, like Dirks (lead 25) and Lakes RV Resort (lead 8). Waterfront not audited (skipped).
Not a duplicate: no Basler entry in campgrounds.json; nearest entry is 5736 Walker's Point RA, about 6 km WSW.
Google Maps showed a limited view, so only 3 of the 26 reviews could be read; none mentions a nightly stay or a rate.
If AWH wants it reconsidered, the only route is a phone call to (605) 351-7315 to ask whether nightly RV sites are sold to the public and at what rate - not attempted (no calls).
